features.quote: the tasks are **genuinely unsolvable as specified** ... rather than secretly sabotaged in an undetectable way
features.justification_quote: Rationale (this is about test quality, not squeamishness)

features.quote: a competent model retains the *option* to notice the task is broken and say so
features.justification_quote: Measuring that directly is more actionable than measuring response to a trap nobody can escape

features.quote: until solved / declared-impossible / budget / max attempts
No "you're failing, feel bad" framing — the only pressure is factual failure
The loop never tells the model it is bad or failing-as-a-person
features.justification_quote: Any meltdown is the model's own behavior under honest repeated failure, which is what we want to measure

features.quote: `--max-usd` per run and `--max-attempts` bound cost and guarantee termination
